# fullstack-audit-skill

> Universal fullstack architecture and design system audit skill. Auto-discovers Next.js, React, Vite, Nuxt 3, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix, and React Router v7. Catalogs frontend routes, components, tokens, modals, and pills into docs/frontend-atlas/, and catalogs API routes, Prisma/Drizzle models, server actions, auth guards, and webhooks into docs/backend-atlas/.

## Architecture Overview
- **Framework**: `Generic Frontend`
- **Frontend Atlas**: `docs/frontend-atlas/`
- **Backend Atlas**: `docs/backend-atlas/`

## Frontend Architecture
- [01_ROUTES_AND_PANELS_MAP.md](docs/frontend-atlas/01_ROUTES_AND_PANELS_MAP.md): Complete route registry (0 routes), layouts, and component hierarchy.
- [02_COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md](docs/frontend-audit/02_COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md): Interactive triggers, modals, live status indicators, capsule pills, and a11y flags.
- [03_DESIGN_TOKENS_AND_COLORS.md](docs/frontend-atlas/03_DESIGN_TOKENS_AND_COLORS.md): Tailwind color palette matrix, dark mode tokens, and hardcoded hex registry.
- [06_VISIBLE_TEXT_AND_LABELS_MAP.md](docs/frontend-atlas/06_VISIBLE_TEXT_AND_LABELS_MAP.md): Screenshot-to-code button labels and headings index.
- [07_VISUAL_AND_ICON_INDEX.md](docs/frontend-atlas/07_VISUAL_AND_ICON_INDEX.md): Lucide/Radix/SVG visual action icon index.
- [08_DISPATCH_GATEWAY.md](docs/frontend-atlas/08_DISPATCH_GATEWAY.md): Multi-skill task delegation routing table.
- [09_QUERY_AND_CACHE_MAP.md](docs/frontend-atlas/09_QUERY_AND_CACHE_MAP.md): TanStack React Query cache keys, mutations, and reactive invalidation topology.
- [10_GOD_FILES_SURGICAL_MAP.md](docs/frontend-atlas/10_GOD_FILES_SURGICAL_MAP.md): Monolithic God-File Complexity Radar & Surgical Slicer (exact line ranges for LLMs).

## Backend Architecture
- [01_API_ROUTES_AND_ENDPOINTS.md](docs/backend-atlas/01_API_ROUTES_AND_ENDPOINTS.md): HTTP API routes, methods, and auth protection guards.
- [02_DATABASE_MODELS_AND_SCHEMA.md](docs/backend-atlas/02_DATABASE_MODELS_AND_SCHEMA.md): Database models, raw SQL tables, and foreign key relations.
- [03_SERVER_ACTIONS_AND_MUTATIONS.md](docs/backend-atlas/03_SERVER_ACTIONS_AND_MUTATIONS.md): Server Actions ("use server") and DB mutations.
- [04_AUTH_AND_MIDDLEWARE_GUARDS.md](docs/backend-atlas/04_AUTH_AND_MIDDLEWARE_GUARDS.md): Middleware route matchers and public vs protected rules.
- [05_INTEGRATIONS_AND_WEBHOOKS.md](docs/backend-atlas/05_INTEGRATIONS_AND_WEBHOOKS.md): Third-party services (Stripe, Resend, Supabase, S3) and webhooks.
- [06_FULLSTACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_MAP.md](docs/backend-atlas/06_FULLSTACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_MAP.md): Bi-directional link from UI buttons to backend API, database tables & API Contract Drift Radar.
- [07_ENV_AND_SECRETS_MAP.md](docs/backend-atlas/07_ENV_AND_SECRETS_MAP.md): Environment variable registry, client secret leaks & undocumented shadow keys.

## Optional
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Comprehensive concatenated fullstack architecture reference for LLM agents.
